name: Allyl isoamyl glycolate
description: Allyl isoamyl glycolate (CAS 67634-00-8 ), also known as allyl (3-methylbutoxy)acetate, is a specialty ester used as a flavoring and fragrance ingredient in food and cosmetic applications. It delivers a fruity, green, and slightly tropical character that makes it a valued building block in flavor and fragrance compositions. In food flavoring, it contributes fresh, fruity top notes to confectionery. It is frequently utilized in beverages and chewing gum formulations where a tropical or green fruit profile is desired. Fragrance houses incorporate it into fine fragrance and functional fragrance blends. This ingredient adds light, diffusive top notes with a natural fruit character to various products. In personal care, it appears in scented rinse-off and leave-on formulations including shampoos and body washes. It is also found in lotions where a fresh, fruity signature is required. Its ester structure supports use as a modifier in complex flavor systems, helping to round and lift other aromatic components. Allyl isoamyl glycolate is supplied as a clear liquid in standard packaging suitable for flavor and fragrance manufacturing. It is available at flavor-grade and fragrance-grade purity levels. Specifications are aligned to industry quality standards for aroma chemicals.
